network.zh: 连接 WebDAV 服务器或远程 Git 仓库执行双向同步

other: fix(markdown): unify code segment scanner across list containers and escape rewritten links (`0738412`)
fix(mirror): harden inode stash fallbacks and support .git pointer files in cleanup (`6f2136f`)
fix(webdav): keep placeholder on unknown PUT transport outcome (`43f731b`)
fix(git): support .git pointer markers and enforce strict tracked file listing (`63cf680`)
fix(sync): verify physical target directory identities before mirror/git writes (`1745e12`)

summary.zh: 像整理浏览器工具栏一样，收起右上角用不上的按钮，让顶栏更清爽
summary.en: Declutter the top-right titlebar like a browser toolbar by hiding buttons you rarely use

storage.zh: 记住你隐藏了哪些顶栏按钮
storage.en: Remember which titlebar buttons you chose to hide

ui:titlebar.zh: 读取右上角按钮列表并按你的开关显示或隐藏它们
ui:titlebar.en: Read the top-right buttons and show or hide them per your settings

new: 插件商店现已提供专属图标和精选展示图片。
顶栏分组及其预览现会根据宿主应用提供的元数据呈现。
fixes: 收到格式错误的项目响应时，插件现会报告协议错误，并且不再预留显示按钮的位置。
设置现会校验顶栏布尔选项，在英文界面中避免显示中日韩文字标签，并将“显示全部”固定在最后一张设置卡片上。

new: The plugin now has a store icon and featured artwork.
Titlebar groups and their previews now reflect metadata provided by the host application.
fixes: The plugin now reports protocol errors when it receives malformed item responses and no longer reserves a reveal slot.
The settings now validate titlebar boolean options, avoid Chinese, Japanese, and Korean labels in the English interface, and keep “Show all” on the last settings card.

improvements: 顶栏图标的管理逻辑已迁移至应用内置的脚本沙盒中运行，提升了运行时的安全性与整体稳定性。
Titlebar icon management now runs inside the application's built-in JavaScript sandbox, improving runtime security and overall stability.
顶栏图标设置中的插槽名称现显示为“AI Agent”，原名称“AI Assistant”已替换。
The titlebar icon slot label now says “AI Agent” instead of “AI Assistant.”

fixes: 恢复了对旧版本主程序的兼容支持，重新补齐旧版存储与界面权限，确保在旧版本中能够正常自定义与隐藏顶栏按钮。
The plugin now restores compatibility with older versions of the app by reinstating legacy storage and interface permissions, ensuring titlebar buttons can be customized and hidden properly.

other: 插件不再申请非必要的存储与界面访问权限，精简了运行所需的权限范围。
The plugin no longer requests unnecessary storage and user interface permissions, minimizing the access privileges required to run.

summary.zh: 像纸质点阵手账本一样，给写作区铺上对齐文字的点阵或方格底纹，支持铺满整块编辑区
summary.en: Give your editor a line-aligned dot or grid paper backdrop, in the text column or full editor

storage.zh: 记住你选好的底纹样式、深浅度和显示范围
storage.en: Remember your chosen pattern, contrast level, and display scope

ui:settings.zh: 在设置页展示和切换点阵、方格底纹与显示范围
ui:settings.en: Configure dot or grid patterns, contrast, and display scope

ui:appearance.zh: 在编辑区正文列或整块编辑区画布底层渲染点阵与方格背景
ui:appearance.en: Render line-aligned dot or grid backdrops across the text column or full editor canvas

improvements: 全编辑区背景的说明现已明确指出，背景覆盖编辑区，不包括侧边栏和标题栏。
The full-editor background description now clarifies that it covers the editor area, excluding the sidebar and title bar.

new: 插件新增了商店图标和精选展示图片。
现在可以选择让背景铺满整个屏幕。
The plugin now includes a store icon and featured artwork.
You can now choose to show the backdrop across the full screen.

improvements: 点阵背景渲染现已迁移至应用内置沙盒中运行，提供更强的安全隔离与运行稳定性。
Dot background rendering now runs inside the application's built-in sandbox to provide stronger security isolation and runtime stability.

fixes: 插件恢复了旧版本宿主应用所需的存储与界面权限，解决了旧版本环境下背景设置与控制界面无法正常加载或保存的问题。
The plugin restores storage and interface permissions on older versions of the host application, resolving issues where background settings and controls failed to load or save.

other: 插件不再申请存储与用户界面的豁免权限，精简了安装与运行所需的系统授权范围。
The plugin no longer requests exempt storage and user interface permissions, reducing the access privileges required during installation and operation.

summary.zh: 复古暗金塔罗主题与灵感抽卡工具，为写作换装并附带每日一牌与三张牌阵

ui:commands.zh: 在命令面板加入快捷入口，直接打开牌桌、每日一牌或牌册

ui:notify.zh: 开启、关闭塔罗模式或切换画面时给出简短提示

ui:appearance.zh: 为编辑区、侧栏、AI 区域和速记小窗换上复古暗金塔罗主题皮肤
ui:appearance.en: Apply the Midnight Copperplate theme skin to the editor, sidebar, AI area, and Quick Note

events:workspace.zh: 切换中英文或主题颜色时，让塔罗按钮和界面同步更新
events:workspace.en: Keep the Tarot button and views in sync when you switch language or theme

events:note_saved.zh: 保存笔记时自动收录对应的大阿卡纳牌面并刷新牌册收集进度

notes:read.zh: 读取笔记标题与摘要用于抽牌、每日一牌和牌册，不会改动任何笔记
notes:read.en: Read note titles and excerpts for card draws, Daily Card, and Deck without modifying notes

ai:complete.zh: 按需为你串讲三张牌阵的写作启发，或在每日一牌提出反方追问
ai:complete.en: Generate writing insights for your 3-card spread or devil's advocate questions on your Daily Card

improvements: 代码块的羊皮纸配色更加柔和，工具提示也与塔罗主题更加协调。
Code blocks now use softer parchment colors, and tooltips better match the Tarot theme.

new: 商店页面现已展示专属图标和主题插画，突出塔罗模式的特色。
点击月亮按钮进入塔罗模式时，现会直接打开牌桌。
The store listing now features a dedicated icon and artwork that showcase Tarot Mode.
Entering Tarot Mode from the moon button now opens the card table directly.

improvements: 塔罗模式现已迁移至笔记应用内置的脚本沙箱中运行，提升了插件的安全隔离性与整体运行稳定性。
Tarot Mode now runs within the note application's built-in JavaScript sandbox, improving security isolation and overall runtime stability.

fixes: 插件增强了启动与界面渲染的容错处理，避免因异常错误导致插件无法启动或视图显示空白。
The plugin now handles unexpected errors during startup and interface rendering more reliably, preventing launch crashes and display failures.
塔罗模式现已重新启用旧版存储与界面权限，恢复了在较旧版本主程序中的正常运行与数据保存支持。
Tarot Mode now reinstates legacy storage and interface permissions, restoring normal operation and data saving on older versions of the host application.

summary.zh: 像 Notion 一样给笔记本、文件夹和笔记换上多彩小图标，在侧栏一眼认出它们
summary.en: Give notebooks, folders, and notes custom icons and colors like Notion so you spot them fast

storage.zh: 记住点击更换图标和同步标签页图标的开关状态
storage.en: Remember your click-to-pick and tab icon sync settings

ui:sidebar.en: Read and update custom icons for notebooks, sidebar notes, and folders

new: 现在可以为每个笔记本选择图标，并在笔记本摘要中查看所选图标。
fixes: 旧版宿主现在可以使用插件所需的存储和界面权限。
other: 插件现在不再申请可豁免的存储和界面权限。

插件现在通过内置的 JavaScript 沙箱运行区块图标功能。

new: You can now choose an icon for each notebook and see the selected icon in notebook summaries.
fixes: Older hosts can now access the storage and UI permissions required by the plugin.
other: The plugin no longer requests exempt storage and UI permissions.
The README now includes animated demonstrations of the icon picker.
The plugin now runs block icon features in the built-in JavaScript sandbox.
本次为维护版本，没有面向用户的变化。
This is a maintenance release with no user-facing changes.

summary.zh: 把笔记自动同步到自有云盘、WebDAV 网盘或 Git 仓库，无需买会员
summary.en: Auto-sync notes to your own cloud folder, WebDAV, or Git repo with no extra subscription

storage.zh: 保存各笔记本的同步设置、同步进度和近期同步记录
storage.en: Save sync settings, progress state, and recent sync history per notebook

notes:read.zh: 读取笔记和附件，用来对比改动并上传同步
notes:read.en: Read notes and attachments to check for changes and upload updates

notes:write.zh: 把远端更新和冲突副本写入本地，并将远端已删笔记移入回收站
notes:write.en: Save remote updates and conflict copies locally, and move remotely deleted notes to Trash

network.zh: 连接你的 WebDAV 网盘或远程 Git 仓库完成多端同步
network.en: Connect to your WebDAV server or remote Git repository to sync notes

events:note_saved.zh: 保存笔记后自动同步改动，无需手动操作
events:note_saved.en: Automatically sync changes right after you save a note

system:notify.zh: 同步出错、出现冲突或需要你确认批量删除时发出提醒
system:notify.en: Alert you when sync fails, finds a conflict, or needs confirmation

system:secrets.zh: 把网盘密码和 Git 访问令牌安全存进系统钥匙串
system:secrets.en: Store WebDAV passwords and Git tokens securely in your system keychain

events:system.zh: 电脑唤醒或重新连上网后，自动补做一次同步
events:system.en: Catch up on missed syncs automatically after your device wakes or reconnects

system:fs.zh: 读写你选择的同步文件夹、本地镜像备份与插件 Git 缓存目录
system:fs.en: Read and write your chosen sync folder, local mirror, and Git cache

system:exec.zh: 调用系统 Git 命令完成仓库状态检查、提交与远端推送拉取
system:exec.en: Run git commands to check repository status, commit, pull, and push

ui:sidebar.zh: 在左侧文件树中隐藏同步插件自带的冲突备份和恢复目录
ui:sidebar.en: Hide sync conflict and recovery folders from the sidebar file tree

fixes: 同步现在会合并基线指纹而不覆盖已有条目，并按键分别认领旧版基线。
Sync now merges baseline fingerprints without overwriting existing entries and claims legacy baselines separately for each key.

improvements: 使用 Git 同步时，Sync 现在会简化提交后推送的流程、在启动时迁移路径，并在同步前验证镜像根目录。
Sync now uses a simpler commit-then-push flow for Git, migrates paths at startup, and verifies the mirror root before syncing.

fixes: 同步现在会校验 Git 仓库和镜像目录的根路径，重置尚未推送的 Git 提交，更新未经验证的同步基准，并隔离文件重命名迁移流程。
Sync now validates the configured Git and mirror roots, resets unpushed Git commits, refreshes unverified sync baselines, and keeps file rename migrations isolated.
同步到 Git 时会保护删除操作的推送，合并不完整的同步基线，并检查根目录身份是否符合预期。
Sync now guards Git deletion pushes, merges partial sync baselines, and checks that the root identity matches the expected value.
同步现在会核对笔记本身份，在迁移时保护已有基线，并更安全地清理恢复过程中的数据。
Sync now verifies notebook identity, protects existing baselines during migrations, and handles recovery cleanup more safely.

summary.zh: 自动把本地图片传到云端图床并换好链接，发博客或换电脑都不裂图
summary.en: Auto-upload note images to your own cloud storage and swap in live links like PicGo

storage.zh: 保存你的图床账号配置、存放路径模板与近期上传记录
storage.en: Save your image host settings, path templates, and recent upload history

notes:read.zh: 扫描笔记里的本地图片路径，找出需要上传的图片
notes:read.en: Scan notes for local image links that need to be uploaded

notes:write.zh: 上传完成后把笔记里的本地图片路径自动换成在线链接
notes:write.en: Replace local image paths in notes with live URLs after upload

network.zh: 把图片上传到 GitHub、Cloudflare R2 或 S3 等云存储
network.en: Upload images to GitHub, Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, or S3-compatible storage

events:note_saved.zh: 保存笔记时自动检测并上传新插入的本地图片
events:note_saved.en: Automatically detect and upload new local images when you save a note

system:fs.zh: 校验并读取笔记目录、拖入或剪贴板中的本地图片文件以供上传
system:fs.en: Check and read local image files from notebooks, drops, or the clipboard for upload

system:clipboard_read.zh: 点菜单栏上传剪贴板时，读取你刚复制的截图或图片文件
system:clipboard_read.en: Read screenshots or image files from your clipboard when uploading from the menu bar

system:clipboard_write.zh: 上传完成或点击最近记录时，自动把图片外链复制到剪贴板
system:clipboard_write.en: Copy the uploaded link or a recent upload URL straight to your clipboard

ui:menubar.zh: 在顶部菜单栏显示上传入口，支持拖图上传与查看最近记录
ui:menubar.en: Add a menu bar icon for drag-and-drop uploads, clipboard uploads, and recent links

ui:commands.zh: 提供上传剪贴板、上传拖入图片和复制最近链接的快捷命令
ui:commands.en: Provide commands for clipboard upload, dropped-file upload, and copying recent links

fixes: 检查本地资源时现在不会跟随符号链接，查询 GitHub 文件 SHA 时也会请求对象表示形式。
Local asset checks now inspect links without following them, and GitHub file SHA lookups request the object representation.

new: 插件新增商店图标和精选展示图片，方便用户在 Block 商店中识别插件。
fixes: 本地文件检查与读取以及 GitHub 上传现在可在 Block 运行环境中正常使用。
图床服务商设置会立即保存，同时保留现有的自动保存状态。

new: The plugin now has a store icon and featured artwork to help users recognize it in the Block store.
fixes: Local file checks and reads, along with GitHub uploads, now work with the Block runtime.
Provider settings are saved immediately, and the existing autosave state is preserved.

new: 设置表单现在会自动保存更改，并在同一行显示连接状态。
凭据发生变化时，插件现在会自动保存配置并测试连接。
The settings form now saves changes automatically and displays the connection status in a single row.
The plugin now saves configuration automatically and tests the connection whenever credentials change.

improvements: 插件已迁移至应用内置的沙箱环境中运行，提升了图片上传时的稳定性和安全性。
The plugin now runs in the application's built-in sandbox, improving stability and security during image uploads.

fixes: 插件现已正确声明剪贴板权限以避免操作失败，并恢复了对旧版本笔记应用的兼容支持。
The plugin now properly declares clipboard permissions to prevent operation failures and restores compatibility with older versions of the note application.

ui:commands.en: Add drop and flush actions to the Command Palette, shortcuts, and right-click menus

ui:panels.zh: 在右侧打开「屎量面板」，查看实时统计、最近战报和快捷按钮
ui:panels.en: Open the Poop Board panel on the right for live stats, logs, and quick buttons

ui:status.zh: 在底部状态栏显示当前总数，点一下就能打开或收起右侧面板
ui:status.en: Show the live drop count in the bottom status bar to toggle the right panel

ui:notify.zh: 操作后弹出轻提示，并在「全部冲掉」前弹窗让你再次确认

ui:appearance.zh: 在编辑区铺上可调浓度的矢量图案背景，深色模式下还会发夜光

system:clipboard_write.zh: 把复制的路径写入系统剪贴板
system:clipboard_write.en: Write the copied path to the system clipboard

improvements: 插件现已迁移至内置脚本沙箱中运行，提升了复制路径时的安全性和运行稳定性。
插件运行环境已切换至内置脚本沙箱，确保更稳定可靠的路径复制体验。
The plugin now runs in the built-in JavaScript sandbox, improving execution security and stability when copying paths.
The plugin runtime has been migrated to the built-in JavaScript sandbox to ensure a more reliable path copying experience.

other: 本次为维护版本，没有面向用户的变化。
This is a maintenance release with no user-facing changes.

fixes: 恢复了旧版本主程序所需的存储与界面权限支持，确保插件在旧版应用中能够正常运行。
The plugin now restores the required storage and user interface permissions to ensure it runs properly on older versions of the host application.

other: 复制路径插件不再申请豁免存储权限或界面权限。
Copy Path no longer requests exempt storage or UI permissions.
插件详情中的作者与代码仓库链接已更新至新的维护组织。
The author and repository links in the plugin details have been updated to point to the new organization.
